cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Apologize for the Lie
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that the concealment or misdirection mattered, even if the underlying choice was defensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You showed me the rescue dog's face and hid the page about eating sofas. I used to make you argue both sides. Where did that lesson go?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, that's one side. Now the side where I agreed without knowing what he'd do to mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Generous, but you're still skipping the difficult paragraph. Before we choose fabric, tell me I should have seen both pages.
